description: Defines classes and structures related to QUIC connection context, including tracing, bug listening, and packet processing within the quic namespace.

classes.name: QuicConnectionTracer
classes.description: Responsible for emitting trace messages for a single QUIC connection.

classes.name: QuicBugListener
classes.description: Helper class for implementing bug reporting in QUIC.

classes.name: QuicConnectionProcessPacketContext
classes.description: Contains information about the packet currently being processed.

classes.name: QuicConnectionContext
classes.description: Per-connection context including tracer, bug listener, and packet info.

classes.name: QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
classes.description: RAII object for managing thread-local connection context switching.

methods.name: PrintLiteral
methods.description: Emit a trace message from a string literal.

methods.name: PrintString
methods.description: Emit a trace message from a string_view.

methods.name: Printf
methods.description: Emit a printf-style formatted trace message.

methods.name: OnQuicBug
methods.description: Handle a bug report with bug ID, file, line, and message.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current packet processing context.

methods.name: QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
methods.description: Switches the current connection context within its scope.
